episodes.topic: Red Sea and Suez: what a chokepoint crisis really costs
episodes.title: Ep. 1 | Red Sea Crisis: What Chokepoints Really Cost
episodes.description: When shipping diverts around Africa, extra fuel is only the tip of the iceberg. Nadia and Rachid's AI voice explore how longer transits wreck vessel rotations, trap container equipment, and shatter MRP schedules in enterprise supply chains. Discover why mapping chokepoint exposure before disruption strikes is the ultimate competitive advantage. If you work in shipping, ports or freight, connect with Rachid on LinkedIn to share what's disrupting your operations. | AI-voiced episode, created and curated by Rachid Ait Bouale.

episodes.topic: Smart ports: what “digital” really means at the quay
episodes.title: Ep. 2 | Smart Ports: Beyond the Dashboard
episodes.description: Many ports claim to be smart just because they use digital dashboards, but true transformation goes much deeper. In this episode, Nadia and Rachid's AI voice explore why real-time data integration across terminals, customs, and trucks matters more than any single shiny technology. Tune in to learn how collaborative logistics actually keeps global supply chains moving. If you work in shipping, ports or freight, Rachid wants your view: connect with Rachid Ait Bouale on LinkedIn and tell him what's disrupting your operations right now. | AI-voiced episode, created and curated by Rachid Ait Bouale.
